title: Dromaius novaehollandiae Lue0043 03
author: Lütgens, Hans
changes: Recording of an emu (Dromaius novaehollandiae), a fellow flightless ratite, standing in for the ostrich's deep booming call. Trimmed to 15.50–17.95 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3.
